posts.text: It was only a matter of time before Trump would lash out at Merz and Germany...

Very interesting poll of Global attitudes toward the Iran war:

81% across 31 countries think their country should avoid getting involved in the war.

In 27 of 29 countries, the proportion who think the US will have a positive impact on the world has fallen.

On average, a greater proportion think China (50%) will have a positive impact on the world than the US (39%) over the next decade.

ipsos.com/en/global-attitude…

At first, I thought Trump was living in an alternative reality in which the war was going splendidly well. I am incessantly convinced that his detached-from-reality positions are due to him not accessing accurate information about what reality currently looks like.

Merz isn't wrong in saying he's "disillusioned" with the US & Israel over Iran because they "claimed at the beginning that they could solve this problem within days. Now I must recognize: It is not solved."

But he is in no position to complain. He applauded the war and as a result, owns the outcome. 

This is typical of some EU leaders who support and help facilitate the US's worst instincts, and then pretend they are innocent when the foreign policy adventure predictably goes wrong.
